title: Restricted weight scale bound
statement: Let a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input have dimension $n>0$, accuracy $a/b$ with integers $a>0$ and $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $S\ge1$. Put $\varepsilon=a/b$ and $R=(n+1)(S+1)/\varepsilon$. The sum $A=\left\lceil 4nbS/a\right\rceil+\left\lceil 4nbS^2/a\right\rceil$ of the inner and outer small-bias scales satisfies $A+1\le 2^{16}R^{11}$.
hypotheses_covered: twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is an integer at least one
